intent: Harden parallel workstream authority transitions so main-owned reservation mutations are versioned, worker boundaries read refreshed integration-base authority, and cursor acknowledgement is the only worker adoption mechanism.
rationale_summary: CAP-0010 already owns parallel workstream reservation/routing and its boundary validator; CAP-0009 remains the continuity owner. The incident exposed an incomplete authority-transition guard, not a need for a new semantic owner: extend CAP-0010 with exact reservation revision transitions and base-authority worker fencing while preserving CAP-0009 CLEAN/BLOCKED semantics.
